headline: Nifty 50 ends week in *broad-based slide*
subline: Market sentiment turned risk-off with notable stock declines.
hero_text: The week saw Nifty 50 drop 2.09% amidst a broad-based decline, ending lower on Friday.

why.title: Broad Market Weakness
why.desc: General decline without a single catalyst.

bonus_text: DIIs bought Rs 1,968.17 Cr, while FIIs sold Rs 930.9 Cr.
movers_note_gainers: HDFC Bank and Dr. Reddy's led the gains in the Nifty 50.
movers_note_losers: Hindalco and JSW Steel were top losers, dragging down sentiments.
watch_text: GIFT Nifty points to a positive start on Tuesday, 15 September 2026.
lessons: This week saw a market-wide decline in absence of a major catalyst.
HDFC Bank's legal victory did not prevent share decline.
Hindalco's announcement failed to uplift its stock price.
Volatility surged, as seen by the India VIX rise.
alert_text: Keep an eye on Tuesday, 15 September 2026 for market cues.
cta_sub: Follow us for daily insights and updates on market trends.
next_text: Look out for Tuesday, 15 September 2026. GIFT Nifty indicates a positive start.
caption_a:
Nifty 50 slid 2.09% during the week, ending -0.34% lower on Friday.

Broad-based weakness, led by steel and IT sectors.
Volatility spiked with India VIX up 4.15%. FIIs sold Rs 930.9 Cr.
